_doc: What every ordinary dish picture shows (assets/tiles/items/dish_*.png), looked at one by one on 2026-11-22. form: the kind of dish it looks like. foods: the foods you can SEE on it (the words in 'foods' below). garnish: its benefit's colour cue (a sprig of herbs for Stat, violets for Special, honey for SP, a blue glow for MP, a red broth for HP), read as the colour and never as a food. dish_art.py places every dish by this catalogue: a dish shows a picture of its form with no counted food it does not contain. A new picture is placed by adding its row here; tests/test_dish_art.py checks that every picture has one.

meat.what: browned meat: a joint, slices, chunks, strips, a steak, a fillet or the flesh on a drumstick

bone.what: a white bone: a soup bone or a drumstick's

sausage.what: sausage links or a coil of sausage

cheese.what: a wedge or cubes of pale yellow cheese

bread.what: a bread roll, bun or loaf

tomato.what: round bright red berries or red chunks, which read as tomatoes (Brandon, 2026-11-22: the Goblin Cheese Grill 'looks like a steak, tomatoes, and sausage')

potato.what: pale potato or root chunks in a stew's gravy, roast roots round a bird: the pot's own, read as part of the stew

onion.what: shreds of pale onion through a stir-fry

pickled_pieces.what: pale pickled pieces under a pickle's brine

garnish.herbs: a sprig of bright green leaves, a green sauce or filling (Stat)
garnish.violets: small violet flowers, a violet sauce, filling or fire (Special)
garnish.honey: an amber-gold glaze, broth or drops of honey (SP)
garnish.glow: a glowing deep blue sauce, broth or drink (MP)
garnish.red_broth: a deep red broth or gravy (HP)
